trophies.deeper: Plan around A Long Road, not around this trophy. Every other trophy feeds it, so the platinum is really a progress bar for the whole guide — check the roadmap timeline to see which phase is holding you back.
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. There is nothing extra to do for it: finish the story, clear the 100% checklist for A Long Road, and mop up every activity, robbery and collectible in this guide.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.deeper: Gone Fishing is also your first look at fishing, which comes back later for Baited My Tackle — pay attention to how the fishing challenge works here.
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end and it pops when the mission completes. It is the first trophy most players earn, and the first step of the story phase.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.deeper: Chapter 1 is the only chapter with a missable trophy hiding in it: do Lucia's balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before the chapter ends, and keep a manual save from the start of the chapter.
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and it pops as the chapter closes (chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene). Nothing here needs a special approach — just play through.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.deeper: Use Chapter 2 to start the long grinds early — scanning vehicles for Whip It Good and trying each activity type for Master of None — since the whole state is open from here.
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish Chapter 2 and it pops as the chapter closes. Chapter 2 is where the map opens up properly: Jason and Lucia become switchable after Breakfast Run, which unlocks most of the partner trophies.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.deeper: Chapter 3 also opens jewelry store robberies through Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which is the setup for Sneakthief. Keep a save from the start of the chapter either way.
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish Chapter 3 and it pops as the chapter closes. The chapter's street-racing strand carries a time-sensitive race — do Race Against Yago the moment it appears, because it feeds the Strangers & Freaks strand count.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.deeper: Before the final mission, make a manual save you never overwrite. There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so a clean pre-finale save is your only way back for anything story-linked.
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish Chapter 4 and it pops as the chapter closes. Bank vault robberies open near the end of this chapter through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is — that is the doorway to Maximum Withdrawal and Hot Together.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.deeper: After the credits, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — the checklist only appears after the story, though work you did earlier still counts toward it.
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy and one of only two golds. Finish the final story mission and it pops. The story does not end the game: everything outside the story stays available after the credits, including the side-story finales and the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.deeper: Once switching is open, call your partner in whenever a trophy says 'with your partner' — Hot Together and Retail Therapy both need the other protagonist beside you.
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2 and it pops. This mission is the one that unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia, so it opens the partner trophies as well as itself.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.deeper: Heist missions are the story's big set pieces. They are unmissable, but they are also good practice for the free-roam robberies later: the same escape-and-lose-the-heat rhythm applies to Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist and it pops when the mission ends. Play it as the story presents it — no preparation or special loadout is needed for the trophy itself.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.deeper: Mission trophies like this one are the backbone of the story phase: six of them sit alongside the five chapter trophies and the finale, so the story phase alone is 12 trophies.
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission Child's Play and it pops when the mission ends. Just follow the story — this one cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.deeper: The name is the mission's own title, so the trophy is really a bookmark for where you are in the story — check the roadmap to see how the mission trophies stack up.
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission Headliners and it pops when the mission ends. Play through the story and it comes to you.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.deeper: Remember the airport layout from this mission: for Catch Me If You Can you need a passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge, at gates E3 or E4, and you take off from there.
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown and it pops when the mission ends. The mission takes place at Vice City International Airport — the same airport where the free-roam trophy Catch Me If You Can is earned later.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.deeper: With the story phase done, the remaining work is all free-roam: side stories, activities, robberies and the world grind. None of it is locked behind the story any more.
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory and it pops when the mission ends. The last of the six mission trophies in the story phase.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.deeper: Do not chase 100% as one grind. The checklist is really a bundle of the other trophies: Cunning Stunts wants 250 of the 300 stunts, One Last Thing wants 50 of the 70 Challenges, Whip It Good wants 100 of the 200 vehicles. Finish the trophies and the percentage follows.
trophies.guide: The biggest single trophy in the list and the second gold. Reach 100% on the in-game checklist, which appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion after the story. The checklist counts story progress, 300 stunts, 70 of the 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 illegal operations, among other items — work done before the checklist appears still counts.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.deeper: There are 397 stunts in the game and the 100% checklist wants 300, so do not stop at 250 — every extra stunt still counts. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all feed the same counter.
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind across Leonida: stunt jumps, flying under bridges, knife-edge flights and base jumps all count. The counter runs in the background while you explore, so a long session of driving and flying through the map moves it steadily. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past the trophy.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.deeper: This is the easiest way to sample the game: one round of each activity type and the trophy pops. It also tells you which activities you actually enjoy before you grind their deeper trophies.
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity in the game at least once — races, fishing, arcade games, shooting range, drone races and the rest. The game has nine activity types; one attempt at each is enough, you do not need to win or finish them all.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.deeper: There are two shooting ranges and 42 gold medals between them. Treat each range as a short practice session: learn the target pattern, then go for gold in one focused run.
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 in total across the two ranges. Each challenge is scored on accuracy and speed, so slow down, aim for clean hits and replay a challenge as many times as you need; there is no limit on attempts.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.deeper: Fourteen drone race locations. Win at least one race at each — you do not need to win every race a location offers.
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 drone race locations. You only need one win per location. Learn the course on a first run, then race it properly; the drone handles like a fast, light aircraft, so cut corners where the course allows.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.deeper: Twenty different races, not twenty wins in the same one. Work through the race list and tick each new race off as you win it.
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida — street races, off-road races and the other race types all count, but each race only counts once. Keep a mental list of the ones you have won and move on to a new race each time rather than repeating a favourite.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.deeper: Fishing is introduced in the opening mission Gone Fishing, so the basics are already familiar by the time you meet Cal. A fishing challenge is a contest, not a free catch — watch Cal's pace and beat it.
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal and beat him in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head: land the better catch in the time given. The fishing you learned in the opening mission is the same system, so the challenge is about execution, not learning a new minigame.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.deeper: Any of the four in-game arcade games counts, so pick the one you are best at and finish a single game of it.
trophies.guide: Complete one full game at any arcade machine — any of the four in-game arcade games counts. Find an arcade, sit down, and play a game through to its end. One completion is all it takes.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.deeper: Only some optional questlines count toward the eight. Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do not count here because they have their own trophies, so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish to see which ones fed it.
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as you explore, each a short questline for a character you meet in the world. Not every strand counts — the ones with their own trophies (Andy, Billy, Tyrone) are separate — so work through the stranger encounters and watch the counter move.
trophies.missableNote: Race Against Yago, a Chapter 3 race in Yago's street-racing strand, is time-sensitive (hourglass icon) and the strand counts toward this trophy. Save first, then race the moment it appears.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.deeper: Challenges are listed under Progress, then Challenges. The 100% checklist wants 70 of the 80, so this trophy's 50 is a waypoint on the way to A Long Road, not a separate grind.
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges — the small feats listed under Progress, then Challenges, covering driving, combat, exploration and more. Most of them complete on their own while you play; check the list now and then and chase the ones that are close.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.deeper: Side-story finales stay open after the story ends, so there is no rush — but they are also the cleanest trophies to clear in one sitting each, since each strand is a short chain of missions.
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play through Andy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Stranger strands unlock as you explore Leonida; Andy's is one of the five named side characters with their own finale trophy. The finale stays available after the story, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.deeper: Kenton's strand is one of the five named side finales. If you are working the side phase in order, clear these five first — they are the most predictable trophies in the phase.
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play through Kenton's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Like the other side-story finales, it stays available after the story ends.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.deeper: Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so do not expect that counter to move when you finish it — it has its own trophy instead.
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play through Billy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. The finale stays available after the story, and it is separate from the Strangers & Freaks strand count.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.deeper: Randy's finale is the only side-story trophy at 20 Gamerscore on Xbox — the others are 15. That is the only difference that matters; the method is the same.
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play through Randy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. The finale stays available after the story ends.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.deeper: Tyrone's strand, like Billy's, does not feed Strangers & Freaks. Finish the five named finales and you will have five trophies plus a clearer picture of the remaining strands.
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play through Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. The finale stays available after the story, and it is separate from the Strangers & Freaks strand count.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.deeper: Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which is what the hunt rewards.
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Work through Bret's hunting questline as Jason and hunt the unique animal it asks for. The questline gives you target decks to follow; take the shot cleanly — a head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine. The exact animal and method are still being confirmed by early guides, so follow the questline's own instructions in game.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.deeper: Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close. Each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time — and never leave Chapter 1 without the balcony session.
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — 18 spots in total. Spots show as purple icons when you are close. Bring your partner, since each spot should count for both characters when you meditate together. WARNING: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation, after Lucia is home (a morning after the mission Down to Earth, when she heads to the balcony of Jason's house), disappears once Chapter 1 ends and is the one spot you cannot go back for. Keep a manual save from the start of every chapter, and do the balcony session the moment it appears.
trophies.missableNote: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears once the chapter ends, and there is no mission replay. Do it the moment it appears (a morning after the mission Down to Earth) and keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.deeper: Card sets are a collectible grind with a clear end: three complete sets. Open packs and trade duplicates as you find them, and treat each set as its own checklist.
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are found across Leonida — in shops, in the world and as rewards — so collect as you play and keep an eye on which sets are closest to complete. Three finished sets is the trophy.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.deeper: WAiNK is the in-game camera app: point it at a landmark and snap it. One hundred locations is a lot of photos, so make it a habit — WAiNK a new place every time you pass somewhere unfamiliar.
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to photograph 100 different locations across Leonida. Open WAiNK, frame a landmark or spot the app recognises, and take the shot. Each new location counts once, so keep moving to fresh ground rather than re-photographing the same view.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.deeper: A bank vault job gives you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so the same escape that earns Maximum Withdrawal can earn this one too — bring your partner and lose the heat together.
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose it and escape the red heat zone. The trophy pops only once you have left the heat zone, not just the flashing search area. Bank vault jobs are the reliable way to reach 4 stars with your partner already with you.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.deeper: The chain breaks if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, so keep the police chasing you between shops. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop — give it a moment before hitting a fourth.
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner in, then rob three shops in a row without losing your Wanted Level between them. Keep the heat on you the whole time: if the stars fade, the chain breaks. Rob the third shop, leave, and wait a few seconds for the trophy to pop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.deeper: Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models — keep scanning past the trophy.
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive and keep a lookout for models you have not seen yet. New areas and new vehicle types both feed the counter.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.deeper: Combat Focus is slow-motion aim: press L3 and R3 while aiming. Adrenaline extends Focus, so use it when you have a full bar and a group in front of you.
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: In a single use of Combat Focus, take down 5 enemies. Trigger Focus (L3 and R3 while aiming) in front of a group — the guards at an illegal operation are a good target — and use an assault rifle to drop five before Focus ends. Adrenaline extends Focus if you need more time.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.deeper: The Snap Gun is the quiet tool: use it on the store's locked back door. Kicking the door in sets off the alarm, so patience at the door is the whole trophy.
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Use the Snap Gun on the store's locked back door — kicking it in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; if someone spots you, reload rather than push on.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.deeper: The 100% checklist wants all eight vaults, so this trophy's five is a waypoint. Vault jobs give a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so bring your partner and the same escape can earn Hot Together.
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. Escape the heat zone after each job for it to count.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.deeper: Like the other robbery trophies, this one pops only once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. Keep driving until the heat is fully gone.
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Watch for armored trucks on the road, hit one, take the cash and then lose the heat completely — the trophy pops once you have left the red heat zone. Bring your partner if you also want the escape to feed Hot Together.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.deeper: Exploration feeds everything else: stunts, WAiNK locations, vehicles and meditation spots all sit in the same corners of the map. A long drive through an unexplored region moves several trophies at once.
trophies.guide: Explore every region of Leonida until the whole map is uncovered. Drive, fly and walk through each area — the trophy tracks map coverage, so sweep through towns, countryside, coastline and islands alike. It pairs naturally with the stunts, WAiNK photos and vehicle scanning.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.deeper: There are nine gangs and 39 illegal operations in total, and the 100% checklist wants all 39 — so this trophy pops on the way to A Long Road if you rob operations as you find them.
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Illegal operations are the gang-run businesses you can raid across Leonida; each gang's operation counts once toward the trophy. Keep raiding new operations and the trophy comes with the territory.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.deeper: Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs and are laundered by selling them to your contacts. The $250,000 total is cumulative, so every laundered dollar counts even across many small jobs.
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; sell them to your contacts to launder them. The total is cumulative across the whole game, so keep laundering every bill you earn and the trophy arrives on its own.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.deeper: The $100,000 is cumulative across every kind of shop — clothes, weapons, food, anything. You will spend a lot of it naturally while buying garages and gear; just check the counter now and then.
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. Every purchase counts — clothes, weapons, food, vehicle parts — and the total is cumulative. It builds up naturally over a full playthrough, especially once you start buying garages and equipment.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.deeper: Buy the eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000, and garages the story gives you do not count.
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property — eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000, and garages the story hands you do not count. Garages are also needed for On the Spot, since each registered car needs a free garage space.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.deeper: Buy garages first and register cheap cars. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray, so the Scooter Bros app is not the only route.
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray.
trophies.name: On the Spot

trophies.deeper: Save first, because the police come fast. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops, so do not land and wonder why nothing happened.
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport (VCIA), steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work; planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. Fly about 1 km away from the airport and the trophy pops. Save first, because the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.deeper: Tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops.
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank — a Rhino — and drive it. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, climb in, and drive and fire until the trophy pops. The description is the hint: 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos.'
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.deeper: Ocean Beach is the same stretch of sand where the stunt biplane flies in the game's marketing shots — a good place to be when you are already exploring the coast for The Goodtime State.
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: On Ocean Beach, order and enjoy a cocktail with the view. Find a beach bar or vendor on the Ocean Beach front, buy a cocktail and drink it there. It is a small moment trophy — one of the oddities that rewards stopping to enjoy Leonida.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.deeper: A vehicle showroom is a place full of expensive cars and glass — the trophy wants the classic GTA exit: straight through the front. Save first, since the police will not love it.
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a vehicle out of a showroom by smashing through its front — the classic GTA exit. Take a car inside a vehicle showroom, then drive it straight out through the glass. The description is the method: smash your way out, in classic style.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.deeper: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs: take all three key valuables — the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb — then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — Kingpin Bowling — complete the follow-through. It is an illegal operation from Chapter 2: bring Sticky Bombs, take the three key valuables (the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the office safe, blown open with a Sticky Bomb), then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation returns later, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.deeper: Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you. Both characters need to reach maximum Strength.
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia — a partnership with mass appeal. Buy a gym membership and train at a gym with your partner along, since the partner trains alongside you. Keep training both characters until each hits maximum Strength and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.deeper: Five hundred actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind — just keep playing the way the game wants you to.
trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies, fights and other criminal acts all feed the counter, so it fills up on its own over a full playthrough. There is no separate grind here — play the game and check the counter now and then.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.deeper: The description is the clue: second time's the charm. This is a hidden oddity whose exact trigger is still being confirmed by early guides — it is listed here with its official description only, and the guide will be updated as the community pins it down.
trophies.guide: A hidden oddity trophy whose exact trigger is still being confirmed by early guides — the game has only just launched, and no reliable method is published yet. The official description, 'Second time's the charm,' suggests a second attempt at something pays off. Check back as the community pins it down; this guide records only what the official description supports.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.deeper: The description is the clue: 'What the hell just happened?' — a hidden oddity whose exact trigger is still being confirmed by early guides. It is listed here with its official description only, and the guide will be updated as the community pins it down.
trophies.guide: A hidden oddity trophy whose exact trigger is still being confirmed by early guides — the game has only just launched, and no reliable method is published yet. The official description, 'What the hell just happened?', points to a surprising moment in the world. Check back as the community pins it down; this guide records only what the official description supports.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.deeper: A melee drive-by means striking from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon — bowl your target over from the car, not on foot. Save first and pick a quiet street so the police do not turn it into a chase.
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Perform a melee drive-by: from a moving vehicle, strike a target with a melee weapon and bowl them over. Get a car moving at a steady speed beside a pedestrian, lean out and swing. One clean hit that bowls the target over is the trophy.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
